Slow Flow Echoes

On a Slow Flow Echoes, music by Tom Caufield. He’s got a new album out that we’re playing but let’s go back to an earlier release. Caufield He’s a fingerstyle guitarist who always finds novel settings for his instrument. He has an album called The Whisper ResistanceI We’ll also hear from pianist Gina Alice reworking a track by Chad Lawson. It’s on a Slow Flow Echoes with John Diliberto from PRX.
